INC11: the current published privacy notice per public-form audience. The form must RENDER the notice it records — display is the first link of the evidence chain, so anonymous visitors read this view.

P0-11: the merged legal/contact + presentation projection every public consumer (footer, contact, legal pages, SEO loader) reads. Definer-side like the other projections; anon never gains launch_settings itself.

anon_write_forbidden.__note__: The three public form tables carry NO anonymous privilege — not SELECT and not INSERT. Phase B moved submission to the `public-form` Edge Function, which writes server-side with the service role only after Turnstile, rate limiting and the privacy-notice gate. launch/verify-current-baseline.sql asserts this as a baseline invariant and aborts ledger adoption if it is broken.
